what: One tiny live call through the OpenRouter provider (scripts/smoke_openrouter.py): no target app, no screenshots. Proves key (Keychain openrouter-api-key), endpoint, slug, pinned routing and tool use.
endpoint: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/messages (Anthropic-compatible Messages API, via the Anthropic Python SDK)
notes: A first identical call earlier proved the same path, but its generation lookup failed: the Messages endpoint's body id is Anthropic's msg_ id, and OpenRouter's gen- id is in the X-Generation-Id response header. The provider reads that header now; this second call is the one recorded here.
effort and cache_control were accepted without error; whether the router forwarded effort cannot be observed from a trivial prompt (native_tokens_reasoning 0).
